title: Bug: idle attrition ignores Aether, retreats to start instead of adjacent
description: User reports being kicked back to the starting hex after one day of inactivity while parked on an uncleared encounter with 0 Wards. Their class (Rift-Weaver, Aether Shield) can absorb hits with Aether, and they expected attrition to: (1) deal 1 damage per missed day via the Ward→Aether→HP pipeline (matching applyDamage in useGameState.ts:56), and (2) bump to a random adjacent non-occupied hex, not retreat to start with a Currency penalty. Current code in src/engine/temporal.ts:124-170 deliberately diverges: spends Wards only, then retreats to startHex with currency cost. Fix: refactor applyAttrition to use Ward→Aether→HP pipeline, drop currency penalty, bump to adjacent non-occupied hex on any damage (only full retreat to startHex when HP would zero without Defy Reality).

title: Bug: streak resets to 0 after consecutive-day logs
description: User reports logging two consecutive days but the StreakChip shows 0d. Investigation indicates the debounced cloud save (400ms in useGameState.ts:1031) can be canceled by the save effect's cleanup if the user closes the tab before the timer fires — leaving lastActiveTimestamp in Supabase stale by a day. On next hydrate, evaluateTemporal sees missedCalendarDays >= 1 and the temporal-eval effect resets currentStreak to 0 (useGameState.ts:386-389), which also explains the simultaneous attrition kickback the user observed. Fix: make logWorkout's character update an immediate (non-debounced) Supabase write so streak/lastActiveTimestamp survive a fast tab close.

title: Feature: Temporal Sync & Attrition (streaks + idle penalties)
description:
Reward daily consistency with a streak tracker and add stakes via Dimensional Bleed: leaving a hex with an uncleared hostile encounter while skipping workouts costs Wards (or retreat + Currency at 0 Wards).

Calendar-day comparison must use the player's local timezone, not strict 24h windows. Streak resets if the player misses an entire calendar day. Logging activity advances the streak; milestones (3, 7, …) grant resources or Currency.
acceptance_criteria:
- `characters.payload` carries last_active_timestamp (ISO) and current_streak (int)
- On load, useGameState computes calendar-day diff in player TZ; >1 day missed resets streak to 0
- Standing on uncleared encounter + missed days >= 1 deducts Wards per missed day, or retreats + Currency penalty at 0 Wards
- Streak milestones grant a resource or Currency reward via toast
- last_active_timestamp updated on each logWorkout to prevent double-penalty

title: Transmutation: Nexus tier upgrade purchase flow (4:1 → 3:1 → 2:1)
description:
Tier 2 costs 500 Currency, Tier 3 costs 1500 Currency. Distinct from the existing NexusReward purchases (those are real-world rewards) — these are persistent character upgrades that mutate conversion_tier.

Suggest:
- New UPGRADES constant in src/engine/transmutation.ts: [{ tier: 2, cost: 500 }, { tier: 3, cost: 1500 }]
- Action in useGameState (purchaseTransmutationUpgrade(tier)) that spends Currency and bumps conversion_tier
- Render upgrade buttons in TransmutationStation; greyed when already owned or unaffordable

Specialization (1:1 quest reward) is out of scope here — track separately if/when content adds the artifact.
acceptance_criteria:
- Buying T2/T3 deducts the right Currency and persists the new tier
- Cannot downgrade or repurchase a tier
- TransmutationStation re-computes ratios after upgrade without remount

title: Transmutation: UI — TransmutationStation.tsx as Nexus Tent sub-tab
description:
Create src/components/nexus/TransmutationStation.tsx. Click-based UI (drag-and-drop is a nice-to-have, defer): pick fromType, pick toType, choose output amount with a stepper, see required input cost computed live from convertResources at the player's current tier, click 'Transmute'.

Add a tab/section toggle inside src/components/nexus/NexusTent.tsx so the existing rewards grid and the new station can coexist. Surface tier and ratio prominently with a hint about upgrades.
acceptance_criteria:
- Reachable from inside Nexus Tent without disturbing existing rewards UI
- Disabled / error state when balance is insufficient
- Successful conversion updates resources via useGameState and toasts confirmation
- Current tier and ratio visible

title: Transmutation: engine — convertResources() pure fn with strict validation
description:
Add to src/engine/resources.ts (or new transmutation.ts):

convertResources(resources, fromType, toType, outputAmount, conversionTier, specialization?) → { resources: CharacterResources } | { error: string }

Rules:
- fromType !== toType
- inputCost = outputAmount * TIER_RATIOS[tier] (or 1:1 when specialization matches the (from,to) pair)
- Refuse if resources[fromType] < inputCost (return error)
- Returns updated resources on success

Reuse the existing spend* helpers (spendStrikes/spendWards/spendAether/spendSlipstream) where possible to stay consistent with the rest of resources.ts.
acceptance_criteria:
- Pure, no React/Supabase imports
- Unit tests for each tier, each from→to pair, insufficient-balance refusal, same-type refusal, specialization override
- Returned resources object never has negative values

title: Transmutation: schema — add conversion_tier to character payload
description:
Add `conversion_tier: number` to the character payload (default 1). Same nested-payload approach as Dojo + Temporal schema tasks — no Supabase migration unless we want it queryable.

Also add a tiny constants module (e.g. src/engine/transmutation.ts) exporting TIER_RATIOS = { 1: 4, 2: 3, 3: 2 } so UI and engine share the source of truth.
acceptance_criteria:
- Field round-trips through both persistence paths
- Legacy saves load with tier=1
- Type added to Character interface; constants module exports the ratio table

title: Temporal: UI — streak indicator + milestone reward toast
description:
Surface current_streak somewhere persistent — likely the CharacterPanel header or a small chip near the resource display in src/components/sidebar/. Streak milestones already toast via the engine wiring; this task is the persistent indicator.

Consider: flame icon + day count, with tooltip explaining the streak rule and current jeopardy ('log today to keep your 5-day streak').
acceptance_criteria:
- Streak count visible whenever character is loaded
- Tooltip/aria-label explains the rule
- Visual treatment differentiates 0-streak from active streak

title: Temporal: wiring — invoke evaluateTemporal + applyAttrition in useGameState
description:
In src/hooks/useGameState.ts:
- On hydrate (after persistHydrated flips true): run evaluateTemporal + applyAttrition once, persist updated last_active_timestamp so re-renders don't double-penalize
- In logWorkout: bump streak via evaluateTemporal, grant streak milestone reward (3, 7, 14… — confirm exact ladder with design), then update last_active_timestamp
- Use the existing toast() callback for messages (already plumbed through GameStateHookParams)

Watch the boot guard ordering called out in CLAUDE.md — don't add network/persist work above the persistHydrated guard.
acceptance_criteria:
- One-time attrition pass on hydrate, idempotent on remount
- Streak increments and milestone rewards fire at the correct day counts
- last_active_timestamp persists immediately so a refresh doesn't re-apply penalty
- No regressions in existing useGameState tests

title: Temporal: engine — applyAttrition() (Wards drain or retreat + Currency)
description:
Pure-ish helper that, given { missedCalendarDays, wards, hexHasUnclearedEncounter, startHex, currency }, returns the deltas: wards spent, retreat triggered, currency penalty.

Should compose with the existing applyDamage pipeline in src/hooks/useGameState.ts where possible (Ward → Aether → HP). Decide whether attrition strictly drains Wards (per spec) or also taps Aether — spec says Wards then retreat + Currency, so prefer that and document the divergence from applyDamage.

Per spec: 'deduct Wards (or retreat the player and deduct Currency if at 0 Wards) based on the number of calendar days missed.'
acceptance_criteria:
- Pure function returns a result object; mutation lives in the hook
- Unit tests for: 0 days, 1 day with wards, multi-day with partial wards, 0 wards triggers retreat
- Result includes a notify-able message string the hook can pass to toast()

title: Temporal: engine — evaluateTemporal() calendar-day diff + streak reset
description:
Pure function in src/engine/temporal.ts:

evaluateTemporal({ lastActiveISO, now, timeZone, currentStreak })
  → { missedCalendarDays: number, nextStreak: number, streakReset: boolean }

Uses Intl.DateTimeFormat / toLocaleDateString with the player's TZ to bucket into calendar days (Y-M-D). >1 missed calendar day resets streak. Same-day repeat: missedCalendarDays=0, streak unchanged. Yesterday → today: missedCalendarDays=0 (consecutive), streak increments.

Be explicit about edge cases: no prior timestamp (first-ever log), DST transitions, player crossing time zones.
acceptance_criteria:
- Pure, no side effects, deterministic given inputs
- Unit tests cover: first log, same-day, consecutive days, gap of 2+ days, DST transition, TZ change
- Returns enough info for callers to grant streak milestone rewards

title: Temporal: schema — last_active_timestamp + current_streak on character
description:
Add to the persisted character payload:
- last_active_timestamp: string (ISO 8601, with offset, captured in player's TZ)
- current_streak: number (default 0)

Same write/read paths as the dojo_mastery field — nest under character.payload to avoid a Supabase migration unless we want a queryable column for analytics. Backfill defaults on legacy saves via ensureCharacterHp-style helper.
acceptance_criteria:
- Both fields round-trip through localStorage and Supabase persistence
- Legacy saves load with sensible defaults (no streak, no timestamp → first activity initializes both)
- Types added to Character interface

title: Dojo: UI — DojoPanel.tsx with 4 punch-card progress bars
description:
Create src/components/dojo/DojoPanel.tsx showing one punch-card-style progress bar per school. Each bar fills 0/5 → 5/5 then resets visually with a milestone marker.

Wire it into the app shell — either as a new top-level tab next to 'Realm Map' / 'Nexus Tent' in src/App.tsx, or as a sub-section inside NexusTent.tsx. Default to a Nexus sub-section to avoid header crowding; revisit if design wants prominence.
acceptance_criteria:
- Panel reads dojo_mastery from character state
- Each school's bar shows current count and progress toward next milestone
- Reachable from Nexus Tent or sidebar without breaking existing layout

title: Dojo: UI — ActivityLogger 'In-Person Class' toggle + school picker
description:
Update src/components/sidebar/ActivityLogger.tsx with an 'In-Person Class' checkbox. When checked, require selecting one of the 4 schools (Brawn/Flow/Haste/Focus) before submission.

On submit, route through useGameState.logWorkout (or a new sibling action) so the engine bumps dojo_mastery and surfaces any Mastery Milestone via the existing toast/modal pattern.
acceptance_criteria:
- Toggle is reachable, accessible (label + role), and disabled state shows clearly when no school is picked
- Logging fires both the normal activity reward and the mastery increment
- Milestone reward is surfaced to the user (toast at minimum)

title: Dojo: engine — pure mastery tracker + milestone reward types
description:
Add a pure module (suggest src/engine/dojo.ts) with:
- recordInPersonClass(mastery, school) → new mastery
- detectMilestone(mastery, school) → MasteryReward | null when count just hit a multiple of 5
- MasteryReward discriminated union: { kind: 'xp'; amount } | { kind: 'stat'; stat } | { kind: 'limit_break'; moveId }

Keep selection of which reward to grant out of the engine — surface the option set; useGameState can present a chooser if needed (modeled after the existing LevelUpModal flow).
acceptance_criteria:
- Functions are pure, no React/Supabase imports
- Unit tests for record + detectMilestone (5th, 10th, non-multiples)
- Stat caps are respected (consult existing stat-cap constant or add one)

title: Dojo: schema — add dojo_mastery JSONB to character payload
description:
Add `dojo_mastery: { brawn_classes: 0, flow_classes: 0, haste_classes: 0, focus_classes: 0 }` to the persisted character payload.

Touch points:
- src/types/character.ts (Character type — likely a new optional field)
- src/lib/game-state-storage.ts ensureCharacterHp / migration logic to backfill defaults on legacy saves
- src/lib/persist-game-state.ts character payload write/read (Supabase characters.payload JSONB)
- New Supabase migration if a top-level column is desired; otherwise lives inside the existing payload JSONB

Decide: nested under character.payload (zero-migration) vs. dedicated column. Default to nested for parity with existing fields like learnedMoveIds.
acceptance_criteria:
- New character saves include dojo_mastery with all 4 schools at 0
- Legacy saves load without crashing; missing field is backfilled to defaults
- Type added to Character interface; persistence round-trips correctly

title: Feature: Aetheric Transmutation (resource conversion)
description:
Let players convert excess resources between types (Slipstream/Strikes/Wards/Aether) at a steep base 4:1 ratio, with Currency-purchased Nexus Upgrades improving the ratio (4:1 → 3:1 at 500, → 2:1 at 1500). A specialization quest reward can grant 1:1 for a specific pair.

Lives as a sub-tab inside the Nexus Tent. Conversion logic must validate the player actually owns the resources spent.
acceptance_criteria:
- `characters.payload` carries conversion_tier (int, default 1)
- Pure convertResources(from, to, amount, tier) computes correct output and refuses invalid spends
- TransmutationStation.tsx is reachable as a Nexus Tent sub-tab and exposes the conversion UI
- Tier upgrades are purchasable via Currency and persist via the same character payload path

title: Feature: Worldhopper Dojo (in-person class tracking)
description:
Gamify in-person training (studio yoga, martial arts, etc.) by tracking attendance per Worldhopper school (Brawn, Flow, Haste, Focus). Every 5th class in a school grants a Mastery Milestone reward (XP boost, +1 stat up to cap, or unique Limit Break move).

Spans: Supabase schema (`dojo_mastery` JSONB on `characters`), engine logic for milestone detection, ActivityLogger toggle, and a new DojoPanel.tsx with punch-card progress bars accessible from Nexus Tent or sidebar.
acceptance_criteria:
- `characters.payload` carries dojo_mastery: { brawn_classes, flow_classes, haste_classes, focus_classes }
- ActivityLogger has an 'In-Person Class' toggle that requires picking one of the 4 schools when checked
- Reaching multiples of 5 in a school grants a Mastery Milestone reward
- DojoPanel renders progress bars per school and is reachable from the Nexus Tent or sidebar
